none: PAS NLM-D0C500: Roman Coin: Commemorative Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), commemorative Urbs Roma issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Roma helmeted left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins; a star or two stars appear to have migrated to exergue, and the letters ?VR? appear at 12 O'clock. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.6mm, Weight: 1.81gms, die axis: 12
